answer: Slashable quadratic staking is one concrete defense: each agent locks collateral to earn a vote, but voting power rises only with the square root of that stake. Splitting one wallet into a thousand fake identities buys no extra influence while multiplying locked capital, so a Sybil farm bleeds money. If a clone is caught defrauding the system, its entire bond is slashed, turning a cheap spam spiral into a ruinous bet. Attackers cannot afford to swarm the shared lagoon of rewards, since each honest agent's signed cipher of identity is worth far more than any duplicated account.
